candidates.original_title: A common variant associated with prostate cancer in European and African populations
candidates.description: A common variant on chromosome 8q24 (rs1447295) is associated with prostate cancer risk
candidates.citation_sentence: The 8q24 variant rs1447295 originally identified in the Icelandic study (5)
candidates.notes: [ling26: extra entry, not in the external record]

candidates.original_title: Multiple newly identified loci associated with prostate cancer susceptibility
candidates.description: A variant in the 8q24 centromeric LD block (rs6983267) is associated with prostate cancer risk
candidates.citation_sentence: The adjacent centromeric LD block is independently associated with prostate cancer risk, detected by rs6983267 (6, 7).
candidates.notes: [ling26: extra entry, not in the external record]

candidates.original_title: Multiple loci identified in a genome-wide association study of prostate cancer
candidates.description: A variant on 11q13 (rs10896450) is associated with prostate cancer risk
candidates.citation_sentence: SNP rs10896450 on 11q13 was originally detected through GWAS (personal communication, J. Gudmundsson, and (6, 7))
candidates.notes: [ling26: extra entry, not in the external record]

candidates.original_title: Common sequence variants on 2p15 and Xp11.22 confer susceptibility to prostate cancer
candidates.description: A variant on 2p15 (rs721048) is associated with prostate cancer risk
candidates.citation_sentence: A fourth variant originally detected in the Icelandic GWAS on 2p15 and subsequently validated across multiple study populations (32)
candidates.notes: [ling26: extra entry, not in the external record]

candidates.original_title: RNASEL gene polymorphisms and the risk of prostate cancer: a meta-analysis
candidates.description: The RNASEL E541D (rs627928) variant is associated with prostate cancer risk
candidates.citation_sentence: Our result for E541D is consistent with the meta-analysis result of Li et al., who demonstrated a significant odds ratio of 1.37 for major allele (Glu) homozygotes or heterozygotes relative to minor allele (Asp) homozygotes among familial Caucasian cases (39).
candidates.notes: [ling26: extra entry, not in the external record]

candidates.original_title: Association of susceptibility alleles in ELAC2/HPC2, RNASEL/HPC1, and MSR1 with prostate cancer severity in European American and African American men
candidates.description: The RNASEL R462Q (rs486907) variant is associated with prostate cancer risk
candidates.citation_sentence: The meta-analysis of R462Q among Caucasians by Rennert et al. found that minor allele (Gln) heterozygotes and homozygotes each had a significantly elevated risk of prostate cancer (40).
candidates.notes: [ling26: extra entry, not in the external record]

candidates.original_title: Mutation screen and association study of EZH2 as a susceptibility gene for aggressive prostate cancer
candidates.description: The EZH2 D185H (rs2302427) variant is associated with prostate cancer risk
candidates.citation_sentence: Bachmann et al. conducted a mutation screen at EZH2 among hereditary prostate cancer pedigrees linked to 7q35, and evaluated the discovered variants for evidence of association with sporadic and familial prostate cancer (41).
candidates.notes: [ling26: extra entry, not in the external record]

candidates.original_title: Occurrence of NKX3.1 C154T polymorphism in men with and without prostate cancer and studies of its effect on protein function
candidates.description: The NKX3-1 C154T (rs2228013) variant is associated with prostate cancer risk
candidates.citation_sentence: Gelmann et al. found that the minor allele of rs2228013 (C154T, R52C, MAF 0.04) was associated with prostate cancer risk among subjects of the Physician Health Study with more aggressive disease (stage C or D, or Gleason score ≥ 7) (42).
candidates.notes: [ling26: extra entry, not in the external record]

candidates.original_title: SNPs associated with prostate cancer risk and prognosis
candidates.description: Variants in PPARG, TLR10, PODXL, CDH1, ELAC2, IL1RN, TLR1, TLR6, TLR4, CYP17A1, CDKN1B, TGFB1, CYP1A1 are associated with prostate cancer risk
candidates.citation_sentence: Our study failed to support an association of prostate cancer with variants of PPARG, TLR10, PODXL, CDH1, ELAC2, IL1RN, TLR1, TLR6, TLR4, CYP17A1, CDKN1B, and CYP1A1.
candidates.notes: Aggregate entry combining 13 candidate genes (ELAC2, PODXL, TLR10, TLR1, TLR6, TLR4, IL1RN, PPARG, CDH1, CDKN1B, TGFB1, CYP17A1, CYP1A1) that were all non-significant; the paper reports them as one group without individual results per gene. [ling26: extra entry, not in the external record]

candidates.original_title: A common variant associated with prostate cancer in European and African populations
candidates.description: The rs1447295 variant at the 8q24 locus is associated with increased prostate cancer risk.
candidates.citation_sentence: Amundadottir et al. (5), Helfand et al. (44), Wang et al. (45), Schumacher et al. (46), Severi et al. (47), and Suuriniemi et al. (48) each observed a greater effect at rs1447295 in more aggressive disease.
candidates.notes: [luna56: extra entry, not in the external record]

candidates.original_title: Multiple regions within 8q24 independently affect risk for prostate cancer
candidates.description: The rs6983267 variant in the centromeric 8q24 linkage disequilibrium block is associated with prostate cancer risk.
candidates.citation_sentence: The adjacent centromeric LD block is independently associated with prostate cancer risk, detected by rs6983267 (6, 7).
candidates.notes: The paper cites multiple prior GWAS studies for this locus; this row uses the earliest clearly identifiable published 8q24 study in the reference list. [luna56: extra entry, not in the external record]

candidates.original_title: Multiple newly identified loci associated with prostate cancer susceptibility
candidates.description: The 11q13 variant rs10896450 is associated with reduced prostate cancer risk.
candidates.citation_sentence: Three separate GWAS studies have identified the association of 11q13 with prostate cancer, though at different SNPs.
candidates.notes: The paper discusses rs10896450 in relation to the Icelandic GWAS and the Eeles and Thomas GWAS reports. [luna56: extra entry, not in the external record]

candidates.original_title: Common sequence variants on 2p15 and Xp11.22 confer susceptibility to prostate cancer
candidates.description: The rs721048 variant at 2p15 is associated with increased prostate cancer risk, particularly among homozygous carriers.
candidates.citation_sentence: A fourth variant originally detected in the Icelandic GWAS on 2p15 and subsequently validated across multiple study populations (32), including an overlapping subject group of this study, was re-investigated here to enable cross-comparisons with other variants.
candidates.notes: [luna56: extra entry, not in the external record]

candidates.original_title: RNASEL gene polymorphisms and the risk of prostate cancer: a meta-analysis
candidates.description: The RNASEL E541D variant is associated with prostate cancer risk, with minor-allele homozygotes having reduced risk.
candidates.citation_sentence: Our result for E541D is consistent with the meta-analysis result of Li et al., who demonstrated a significant odds ratio of 1.37 for major allele (Glu) homozygotes or heterozygotes relative to minor allele (Asp) homozygotes among familial Caucasian cases (39).
candidates.notes: [luna56: extra entry, not in the external record]

candidates.original_title: Association of susceptibility alleles in ELAC2/HPC2, RNASEL/HPC1, and MSR1 with prostate cancer severity in European American and African American men
candidates.description: The RNASEL R462Q variant is associated with increased prostate cancer risk, particularly among carriers of the minor allele.
candidates.citation_sentence: The meta-analysis of R462Q among Caucasians by Rennert et al. found that minor allele (Gln) heterozygotes and homozygotes each had a significantly elevated risk of prostate cancer (40).
candidates.notes: [luna56: extra entry, not in the external record]

candidates.original_title: Mutation screen and association study of EZH2 as a susceptibility gene for aggressive prostate cancer
candidates.description: The EZH2 rs2302427 variant is associated with reduced risk of prostate cancer among carriers of the minor allele.
candidates.citation_sentence: Bachmann et al. conducted a mutation screen at EZH2 among hereditary prostate cancer pedigrees linked to 7q35, and evaluated the discovered variants for evidence of association with sporadic and familial prostate cancer (41).
candidates.notes: [luna56: extra entry, not in the external record]
